title: Regiment and Lantern
author: A. M. Lockridge
blurb: Rosalind Zhou, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
